title: Governance Chain Rollup (Phase → Group → Stage → Step)
description: Shape of a single project Phase as a 4-level rollup: Phase contains Groups (PMBOK 8 process groups), Group contains Stages (the 18-stage Intent-to-Outcome chain), Stage contains Steps (the stage's own operational procedure). Mirrors docs/intent-to-outcome-chain-coverage.md; that document wins on any disagreement. No agent tool writes this file's content automatically — status fields are set by a human from real evidence (Project-Status-Register.md, gate episodes), never invented.

status.description: blocked/gap outrank in_progress, which outranks not_started, which outranks done, when rolling a child status up to its parent (see rollupRule on Phase).

gateMode.description: policy: a registered approve-* TaskPolicy needs a human-approved approval. evidence: no approval policy; done needs evidence references. human_review: no registered policy; one human sign-off. pipeline: Stage 16's paired classify/escalate pipeline.

title.description: Short imperative description of the step.

isGate.description: True when this step is the stage's own approval/evidence gate rather than a drafting or checking step.

evidence.description: Paths, commit hashes or episode ids that show the step is done. Empty until evidence exists; never filled with an invented value.

name.description: Canonical display name, exactly as docs/intent-to-outcome-chain-coverage.md gives it. Never abbreviated.

pmbok.description: PMBOK 8 process group and number/name this stage maps to.

artifacts.description: The documents or directories this stage's steps read or produce.

stepsSource.description: Path to the authoritative process guide these steps were taken from, when one exists beyond stages.json/the coverage doc (e.g. a Methodology/Stage-N-*.md for stages 15-18). Omitted for stages with no separate guide.

name.description: Exact group string from stages.json/the coverage doc. Never written as "M&C" or similar.

id.description: e.g. "Phase 1". One cycle is one project phase.

startedAt.description: Set only from a recorded stage_start decision. Null until then.

closedAt.description: Set only once stages 17 and 18 are both recorded done. Null until then.

rollupRule.const: A node's status is the most-blocking status among its children, ranked blocked/gap > in_progress > not_started > done. A Stage is 'done' only when every one of its Steps is 'done'; the same rule rolls Stage status up to Group, and Group status up to Phase.
rollupRule.description: Documents the rollup rule; not meant to be edited.
